description: Nigeria - NMIS education facility data is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Energy demand", published or maintained by Ms. Funlola Osinupebi (Nigerian Rural Electrification Agency ). The Nigeria MDG (Millennium Development Goals) Information System – NMIS education facility data is collected by the Office of the Senior Special Assistant to the President on the Millennium Development Goals (OSSAP-MDGs) in partner with the Sustainable Engineering Lab at Columbia University. Coverage: Nigeria. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, CSV. The portal files it under Energy access, Energy demand. The portal gives 2014 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
